newsitem.title: USA: Panel OKs Atmos,United Cities merger.
newsitem.headline: Panel OKs Atmos,United Cities merger.

text.p: Atmos Energy Corp and United Cities Gas Co said that the Illinois Commerce Commission has approved their merger.

"The approval by the Illinois Commerce Commission is the final approval required for the merger of United Cities and Atmos. We expect to close the transaction in the last week of July," Atmos Chairman, President and Chief Executive Robert Best said in a statement.

United Cities distributes natural gas and propane gas to about 350,000 customers in 10 states. Atmos provides natural gas service to more than 680,000 customers in Texas, Colorado, Kansas, Missouri, Louisiana, and Kentucky.
